mapper.select: SELECT A.*, E.name AS emp_name FROM ATT A JOIN EMP E ON A.emp_id = E.emp_id WHERE A.att_id = #{attId}
SELECT A.*, E.name AS emp_name FROM ATT A JOIN EMP E ON A.emp_id = E.emp_id WHERE A.emp_id = #{empId} ORDER BY A.work_date DESC, A.check_in ASC
SELECT A.*, E.name AS emp_name FROM ATT A JOIN EMP E ON A.emp_id = E.emp_id WHERE A.work_date = #{workDate} ORDER BY A.emp_id ASC
SELECT A.*, E.name AS emp_name FROM ATT A JOIN EMP E ON A.emp_id = E.emp_id WHERE A.work_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} ORDER BY A.work_date DESC, A.emp_id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ATT ( emp_id, work_date, check_in, check_out, assign_id, use_yn, note, reg_ip, reg_date, reg_us_id ) VALUES ( #{empId}, #{workDate}, #{checkIn}, #{checkOut}, #{assignId}, #{useYn}, #{note}, #{regIp}, #{regDate}, #{regUsId} )
mapper.update: UPDATE ATT SET check_in = #{checkIn}, check_out = #{checkOut}, assign_id = #{assignId}, use_yn = #{useYn}, note = #{note}, mod_ip = #{modIp}, mod_date = #{modDate}, mod_us_id = #{modUsId} WHERE att_id = #{attId}
